maya: Quick sync idea — product wants to trial an 'onboarding slot auction' for the model catalog next quarter. We have constrained GPU buckets and want a fair way to allocate early onboards. Need to align on prioritization, launch criteria, and how pin/deprecation interacts with slot winners.
noah: Can you sketch what a slot actually buys? e.g., guaranteed throughput, longer pin window, SLA?
sam: short answer: early-bird credits + a 90d pin grace? but need to model cost.
lina: propose 3 slot tiers: Bronze (30d pin + small credit), Silver (90d pin + medium credit + SLA bump), Gold (180d pin + larger credit + priority canary). Slots consume Dedicated reservation slices.
ada: @lina small nit: Dedicated customers already have reservation slices — we can't double-allocate. Slots should be predominantly for Hosted customers moving to Dedicated or for onboarding heavy open-source models.
nada is a typo; fix to ada — message correction follows.

ada: (ignore spam above, my keyboard freaked)
ada: Re: reservations — engineering needs a clear SLA for slot-backed pins. If a model wins Gold slot we need a compatibility shim strategy when a pinned model is deprecated upstream. We can't break customers.
ada: Suggest auto-fallback routing: pin -> pinned-variant -> fallback-model; runtime would record which variant served for audit.
ops-bot: Current Dedicated avail by bucket: prod-us-east-1: 42 GPUs free, prod-us-west-2: 8 GPUs free, staging: 16 GPUs free. (snapshot 3123456800)
deploy-bot: Canary lane usage this week: 6/10 canaries occupied, average lat P95 220ms, token cost delta +12% when pinned models run at larger sequence lengths.
noah: For prioritization: do we auction with bids (credits) or score by impact (active customers + revenue + infra fit)? Auction may be fast but could privilege wealthier customers.
lina: prefer hybrid: 60% merit score (engage, revenue, compat risk), 40% bid. Helps fund the credits pool for smaller customers.
sam: What are launch criteria? I propose: 1) SLA contract text for slots, 2) compatible pin-vs-deprecate runbook, 3) telemetry to show slot ROI (latency, cost delta, customer-reported quality), 4) pilot with 5 customers.
maya: +1. Add quality guardrails: baseline eval set must pass (we need pre-onboard eval harness). If a model fails quality after a pin, ops should be able to unpin and migrate without manual signoff.
ada: Unpin rollback flow needs API endpoints. Something like: `POST /catalog/v1/pins/{pin_id}/rollback` and `GET /catalog/v1/pins/{pin_id}/audit` so customer success + legal have artifacts.
ada: Also, define TTL semantics: pinned models by slot should have a visible expiry timestamp in the console and an automated renewal offer (with reduced credits if they move to dedicated).
deploy-bot: quick snippet for pin command we already have in proto: ```
rctl catalog pin --model tpu-gpt2-neo --duration 90d --tier silver --notes "slot-winner"
```
noah: Risk: if pinned models are older and we introduce a compat shim service, that's additional runtime overhead. Need to estimate cost and perf impact.
ada: Engineering ask: give rough perf delta for shim vs native path and max concurrent pinned variants per GPU node.
ada: Also: what about downstream eval drift? We need a nightly eval job that compares pinned-model outputs vs current default on a set of customer prompts. Alert on >X% semantic drift.
maya: Ops question: how to surface migration windows? Customers should be notified 30/14/7/1 days before pin expiry and given migration options.
ada: Recommend an automated migration offer in Console: 1-click migrate to suggested variant, 2-click schedule a canary cutover.
lina: For pilot cohort, propose mix: 2 small OSS startups, 2 mid-market SaaS, 1 enterprise (we need legal signoff for enterprise slot terms).
sam: Timeline: backlog groom next Tue, engineering spike for shim & API by end of sprint (2 weeks), pilot recruitment by end of month, pilot run 6-8 weeks.
noah: Customer pricing thought: auction proceeds fund credits and escrow for unintended rollback costs. Need finance input.
maya: Action items: @ada run perf spike for shim (due in 9 business days), @noah draft hybrid auction rubric and sample scoring weights (due EOD Friday), @lina draft slot SLA and renewal text (legal looped) by next Wed, @maya coordinate pilot recruitment and comms.
ada: I can also prototype the `rollback`/`audit` endpoints as simple stubs this sprint.
ops-bot: Reminder: If slots are offloaded to Dedicated, we must update the autoscaler limits file: `infra/autoscale/catalog_slots.yml` — open PR required.
noah: One more thing — pin TTL/expiry should not auto-delete artifacts; must keep models in cold blob for 180d for regulatory replay. Add to SLA.
maya: ok team — thanks. If no objections I'll consolidate this thread into a short DOC and post to the roadmap board. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're good, or DM me concerns.
